cohorts.label: Max-tier, prompt v2 (highest declared tier per exact route)

limitations: This is an immutable snapshot, not a live campaign monitor.
Scores are craft-v7 auxiliary tonal-development diagnostics, not musical-quality ranks.

Ranking uses the best eligible score among three predetermined ordinals under the same frozen condition. Ties use the lowest ordinal. Every eligible ordinal remains playable. Failed and unstarted slots have no score. Infrastructure reruns replace their ordinal's failed sample, not add another repetition.

'Highest declared tier' means the highest documented reasoning control on that exact route (for example max, xhigh, high, thinking-on or none-available), not equal compute: levels are vendor-specific and not comparable across providers. 'Provider default effort' means no reasoning control was sent. Each cohort is published in its own table and never ranked with another cohort.
MP3 is a listening derivative. WAV is the original canonical evaluation audio; XM is the original module.
List-price estimates use maker prices retrieved 2026-09-29, not actual provider bills.
The historical 2026-09-29 prototype dataset is not mixed into this snapshot.

Max-tier, prompt v2 (highest declared tier per exact route): all 56 models retain three predetermined ordinal slots. The best eligible score is ranked and every eligible sample remains playable. Failed and unstarted slots are listed without media or invented scores. Attempts outside the frozen condition never count as repetitions.

Max-tier, prompt v2 (highest declared tier per exact route): a later rerun queue covers 40 models. Their provider-limit, infrastructure and unstarted attempts were rerun as separate attempts under the same frozen condition. Each attempt shows the last run of its chain; the runs it superseded are listed without media. Scored attempts and model failures are never rerun.

flag_rules.PHRASE_SAMPLE: A used sample plays over 8 s at its root note, or over 25% of the song.
flag_rules.SAMPLE_HEAVY: Used sample seconds at root notes exceed 50% of the song length.
flag_rules.ONE_INSTRUMENT: Only one instrument is ever triggered.
flag_rules.SPARSE: Fewer than 64 note-ons, or fewer than 2 channels ever triggered.
flag_rules.SILENCE: Over 20% of 100 ms blocks below -60 dBFS, or a silent run over 4 s.
flag_rules.TAIL_SILENCE: Over 1 s of silence before the end of the render.
flag_rules.CLIPPING: Over 0.1% of samples at full scale.
flag_rules.FLAT: 95th-to-10th percentile block RMS range under 2 dB.
flag_rules.SEAM: Worst measured FT2 loop transition below 50%, or no restart observed.
flag_rules.MASKED: Lead melody masked in over 35% of its bands (diagnostic only).
flag_rules.RAW_XM: tune.xm was written without module_save (allowed; recorded).
